$comment: Whether a place lies within a vision point's reach, as the fog is drawn: inside a circle on the Mercator plane around the point's place, as many kilometres across as it sees at its own latitude. The gateway holds back what the page draws the fog over by this arithmetic, so both ends are held to these rows. Read by the Kotlin protocol test and by the browser. Generated by an implementation independent of both; do not edit by hand. Every place is at least a hundredth of the reach from its edge, so no rounding decides a row. The wide reach due north is the row a distance along the globe would get wrong: 480 km of a 500 km reach on the globe, and outside the circle the map draws.
